blocks.body:
name = "acme/outputs-typo"
version = "1.0.0"
[sandbox]
workdir = "/app"
outputs = [{ pth = "/app/out.txt" }, { path = "/app/out", save_as = "/etc/x", max_bytes = -1 }, "/app/log.txt", "relative/x", "/a/../b", 5, { path = "/x", exclude = "*.pyc" }]

diagnostics.message: unknown key 'pth' in [sandbox] outputs[0]; did you mean path? an output holds path, save_as, and max_bytes (exclude and service come from Harbor imports), or x- extensions
[sandbox] outputs[0] needs a path: an absolute path to a file or a folder in the sandbox
[sandbox] outputs[1] save_as is a relative name for the saved copy, without ..
[sandbox] outputs[1] max_bytes is a positive number of bytes or a size such as "100 MB"
[sandbox] outputs[3] path relative/x is relative; an output's path is absolute, such as /work/relative/x
[sandbox] outputs[4] path /a/../b climbs out with ..; write the path it means
[sandbox] outputs[5] is a path or a { path, save_as, max_bytes } table
[sandbox] outputs[6] exclude is a list of patterns
